notes: Couples in play will reach marriage (owner, 2026-09-23: 'yes both. all the way'). A marriage is a legal act governed by the place it happens, so the game cannot treat it as one national button.

The owner's standing rule for unresearched jurisdictions applies: real law where read, a realistic national range otherwise, never a neighbor's law. The request covers all 56 places the game will hold.
question: In each of the 50 states, D.C., Puerto Rico, Guam, the U.S. Virgin Islands, American Samoa and the Northern Mariana Islands, what does it take to marry: minimum age with and without consent, the license (who issues it, fee range, waiting period, how long it stays valid), who may officiate and whether witnesses are needed, whether common-law marriage can still be formed, and what a divorce requires at the simplest (residency period, waiting period, no-fault availability)?
requestedBy: Relationships thread, building couples on the owner's 2026-09-23 answer; under the rule that depth is not invented.

sourcesChecked.whatItDidNotSettle: Reads a legal:marriage partnership for judicial conflicts but says nothing about how one is formed or where.

title: How a marriage is made, place by place
usableAnswer: One row per jurisdiction (56) with minimum age, license issuer, waiting period and validity, officiant and witness rules, common-law marriage status, and the simplest divorce's residency and waiting periods, each cited.
whyItMatters: Marriage in play has to follow the law of the place the couple lives, and divorce has to exist for couples to end.
